name: cmd_album_reorder
description: Reorder Album (command `album.reorder`). Params: {id, parent?: folderId|null, before?: albumId|null} — places the album (or folder) in `parent` (default: where it is; null: the top level) before the sibling `before` of the same kind, or last of its kind; the folder is then ordered by hand. One undo step. → {changed}: how many edits it took (0: already there).
